newsitem.title: USA: USDA to survey 17,000 farmers on economic health.
newsitem.headline: USDA to survey 17,000 farmers on economic health.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Thursday said it would survey 17,000 producers over the next three months to gauge the economic health on farms.

USDA said farmers will be asked detailed questions about their operations by USDA's National Agricultural Statistics Service, such as farm income and expenses, assets and liabilities, production costs, and risk management strategies.

USDA said the information will be used to measure the impact of the 1996 Farm Bill, estimate the cost of producing food and fiber commodities, determine needs for credit and conservation programs and to develop new production and management strategies to improve farmers' profitability.
